description: File name of the forward (R1) sequencing reads for the sample (fastq.gz).
Chlorophyll a concentration of the water sample. The unit is not stated.
Ice bricks packed for the trip. The values are vehicle or boat names, so this looks like a misfilled logistics column.
Nitrate concentration of the water sample. The unit is given in the no3_unit column.
Invoice number. The values are small whole numbers.
File name of the reverse (R2) sequencing reads for the sample (fastq.gz).
Record of who or what checked the data quality. The values are vehicle or boat names, so it looks like a misfilled column.
Temperature at which the filters or samples were stored.
Dissolved inorganic carbon concentration of the water sample. The unit is given in the dic_unit column.
How the cells were broken open during extraction (physical, chemical and enzymatic).
Version of the data sheet. The values are vehicle or boat names, so it looks like a misfilled column.
Sampling location described in words (Atlantic Ocean, east of Florida, at 27 N).
Biome the sample came from, with its ontology code (marine biome).
Sequencing instrument used for the run (Illumina MiSeq).
Longitude of the sampling station in decimal degrees (negative is west).
Full description of the filter used (Millipore Sigma Sterivex-GP unit, 0.22 µm polyethersulfone membrane, sterile).
Field identifier for the station and depth (for example GOMECC4_27N_Sta1_Deep). It is shared by the replicates of one station and depth.
Salinity of the water sample, on the practical salinity scale.
Whether a travel allowance was claimed. The values are vehicle or boat names, so it looks like a misfilled logistics column.
Place where the freezer holding the extracted DNA is kept (AOML Room 248).
Short index (barcode) sequence added to the forward primer to identify the sample.
Local habitat the sample came from, with its ontology code (for example marine mesopelagic zone, marine photic zone).
Links to the public records for the sample in the sequence archive (run, biosample and bioproject), separated by a vertical bar.
Turnaround time for the service, in business days. The values are vehicle or boat names, so it looks like a misfilled column.
Freight charge in Australian dollars. The values are vehicle or boat names, so it looks like a misfilled column.
Unit of the dissolved inorganic carbon concentration (µmol/kg).
Vehicle odometer reading at the start of the trip. The values are vehicle or boat names, so it looks like a misfilled column.
Page number of the calibration log for the instruments used.
Whether the sample came from an artificial environment: 1 for yes, 0 for no. All rows here are 0.
Link to the written DNA extraction protocol (Zenodo record, version and file name).
Reference number of a service quote. The values are vehicle or boat names, so it looks like a misfilled column.
Purchase order number. The values are small whole numbers.
Price per sample excluding GST. The values are vehicle or boat names, so it looks like a misfilled column.
Hours of overtime worked. The values are vehicle or boat names, so it looks like a misfilled column.
Hours the boat was used. The values are vehicle or boat names, so it looks like a misfilled column.
Number of raw sequencing reads obtained for the sample.
Courier consignment number for the shipment. The values are small whole numbers.
Latitude of the sampling station in decimal degrees (positive is north).
Unit of the nitrite concentration (µmol/kg).
Identifier of the PCR plate that the sample was amplified on.
Distance travelled on the trip. The values are vehicle or boat names, so it looks like a misfilled column.
Number of eskies (cooler boxes) used for transport. The values are whole numbers.
Cost centre that the work is charged to. The values are vehicle or boat names, so it looks like a misfilled column.
Pore size of any pre-filter used before the main filter. Recorded as no pre-filter here.
Type of blank or negative control run alongside the sample. Empty for all rows here.
Name of the DNA extraction kit used (ZymoBIOMICS 96 MagBead DNA Kit).
Water temperature measured at the sampling depth.
Service level for processing, Standard or Express. The values are vehicle or boat names, so it looks like a misfilled column.
Project name or code (noaa-aoml-gomecc4).
Fuel cost for the trip in dollars. The values are vehicle or boat names, so it looks like a misfilled column.
Kind of record in the row. All rows here are samples (as opposed to blanks or controls).
Material that was sampled, with its ontology code (sea water).
Whether GST applies to the charge. The values are vehicle or boat names, so it looks like a misfilled column.
Deepest depth at which the water sample was taken.
Preservative added to the sample. None was used.
Unit of the nitrate concentration (µmol/kg).
Pore size of the filter membrane.
DNA sequence of the forward primer.
Unit of the dissolved oxygen concentration (µmol/kg).
Name of the sequencing library prepared from the sample.
Material of the filter membrane (polyethersulfone).
Whether the field sheet has been scanned. The values are vehicle or boat names, so it looks like a misfilled column.
Registration number of the vehicle used. The values are vehicle or boat names rather than registrations.
Short description of how the water was processed: pumped through a 0.22 µm Sterivex filter with a peristaltic pump.
Time allowed for the DNA precipitation step. Recorded as not applicable here.
Short index (barcode) sequence added to the reverse primer to identify the sample.
Unit used for the volume of water collected (millilitres).
Place where the freezer holding the filtered samples is kept (AOML Room 248).
Names of the sequencing assays (marker panels) that the sample went into, separated by a vertical bar.
Whether the gate key was returned: Y for yes, N for no.
Volume of water collected. The unit is given in the vol_collected_unit column.
Temperature used for the DNA precipitation step. Recorded as not applicable here.
Equipment used to collect the water sample (a Niskin bottle on a CTD rosette).
Shallowest depth at which the water sample was taken.
Name of the reverse PCR primer (926R).
Link to the written sampling protocol (Zenodo record, version and file name) that was followed to collect the sample.
Target gene or marker that was sequenced (16S rRNA, prokaryote small subunit).
Identifier of the sequencing run (run date followed by the run type, here a paired-end 250 bp amplicon run).
How long the sample was stored before processing, written as a duration (P6M means 6 months).
DNA sequence of the reverse primer.
Region of the 16S rRNA gene that the primers amplify (V4-V5).
Unique sample name, made up of the cruise, station, depth and replicate letter (for example GOMECC4_27N_Sta1_Deep_A).
Method used to purify the extracted DNA (magnetic beads).
Dissolved oxygen concentration of the water sample. The unit is given in the do_unit column.
Nitrite concentration of the water sample. The unit is given in the no2_unit column.
Unit of the amount of sample put into the DNA extraction (millilitres).
Amount of sample put into the DNA extraction, which matches the volume of water filtered. The unit is given in the ext_input_unit column.
Centrifuge speed used during processing, as a multiple of gravity. Recorded as not applicable here.
Reagent used to precipitate DNA during extraction. Recorded as not applicable here, as the samples were extracted with magnetic beads.
pH of the water measured at the sampling site.
Name of the forward PCR primer (515F-Y).
Status of the upload to a public database. The values are vehicle or boat names, so it looks like a misfilled column.
Depth of the sea floor at the station.
Sequencing technology or platform used (Illumina).
Date and time the sample was collected, with the local time zone offset from UTC.
